dedupe_keys.name: transport de marchandises par la route i48

description: Transport de marchandises par la route (i48) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Federal Planning Bureau. Definition: the modal share of road in freight transport is the share of total traffic carried by lorries and vans. The other modes of transport considered are railways and waterways. Traffic is measured in tonne-kilometres, obtained by multiplying, for each trip, the number of tonnes on board by the number of kilometres performed. Coverage: Federal Planning Bureau. The portal shows the English title as "Road freight transport (i48)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Federal Planning Bureau. Its keywords include G09_FTR. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
